item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q022_colg_crya_remote_homology","answer":"SCOPe promoted the ColG collagenase collagen-binding domain from a different fold into the same homologous superfamily as the Cry toxin C-terminal domains. In SCOPe 2.04, 1nqd ColG d1nqda_ was classified as all-beta class b, CUB-like fold b.23, collagen-binding-domain superfamily b.23.2, family b.23.2.1; 1dlc Cry3A C-terminal domain d1dlca1, residues A:500-644, was instead all-beta class b, Galactose-binding domain-like fold b.18, Galactose-binding domain-like superfamily b.18.1, delta-Endotoxin C-terminal family b.18.1.3. Thus in 2.04 the two domains did not share a SCOPe fold or a SCOPe homology call. In the current public release, SCOPe 2.08, d1nqda_ is b.18.1.36, the Collagen-binding domain family, under the same b.18 fold and b.18.1 superfamily as d1dlca1, while d1dlca1 remains in the separate delta-Endotoxin C-terminal family b.18.1.3. The relationship is therefore remote homology at superfamily strength, not membership in the same close family. The current ColG family node also records PubMed 17977833 as evidence for likely homology among ColG collagen-binding domains, Clostridium perfringens enterotoxin C-terminal domains such as d2quoa_, and Bacillus thuringiensis Cry C-terminal domains such as d1w99a3; the stored representative structure stream is consistent with that paper-level claim, because the 1nqdA chain itself has no stored FATCAT hits but its 99.16%-identical representative 1nqjA hits d2quoa_ at p=1.4e-6 and d1w99a3 at p=0.00395. Functionally, the common theme is a beta-sandwich binding module appended to bacterial extracellular toxins or enzymes: ColG uses this module to bind collagen, CPE uses the C-terminal domain for receptor binding, and Cry3A's homologous C-terminal domain belongs to the receptor/glycan-binding end of three-domain Cry toxins. That supports an ancestral binding-domain interpretation, but it is not safe to transfer the insecticidal pore-forming activity of Cry3A to ColG, to transfer collagen specificity from ColG to Cry3A, or to model family-specific loops and ligand contacts from one family onto the other; templates are most defensible for the conserved b.18.1 beta-sandwich core.","evidence_used":["get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/current; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1nqda_; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1nqda_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dlca1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1dlca1/parents","get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1nqda_; /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1nqda_/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1dlca1; /api/v1/releases/2.04/sids/d1dlca1/parents","get_scop_node: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267607; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267607/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267607/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267607/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/49785; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/49785/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/49785/homology","get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1w99a3; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1w99a3/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d2quoa_; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d2quoa_/parents","get_scop_chain_hits: /api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/1nqdA/hits?limit=50; /api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/1nqjA/hits?limit=50"]}]}
